title: Orbital Matter 3D-printed the first rigid beam in the vacuum of space | TechCrunch
summary: A satellite built by the German startup Orbital Matter 3D-printed a half-meter long beam out of a custom plastic material, in what executives called a first for a free-flying spacecraft in orbit, and a step toward constructing large structures in space.
